title: Engram's test launcher cannot feed a host with test evidence: a stage passes on exit zero, with no kind and no executed-test count
outcome: A run of Engram's launcher leaves, for each stage, a record a host can read to mint verification evidence: what kind of check the stage was, its state and its own exit status, and for a test stage whether tests were executed and how many passed, failed, were ignored and were filtered out. The record carries no source revision; the host measures its own.
acceptance: A test stage records executed, passed, failed, ignored and filtered counts taken from the runner, and a stage that executed zero tests is not recorded as passed tests
Each stage record states its kind (test, lint, build, docs or other) and a stage that is not a test cannot be read as test evidence
Full and focused modes both produce the record, including for a run in a linked worktree and for a run that completes in the background
The record carries no source revision, and the launcher's own input fingerprint is never presented as the host's source revision
The shape of the per-stage record is agreed with the TermAl owner before implementation, and the agreement is recorded on this item
docs/development.md describes the record and who may treat it as evidence

completion.summary: Landed as a42abb1 (Engram::Fable rounds 1–9, Engram::Opus rounds 10–13). Every run of scripts/test-launcher.mjs that executed its stages now ends stdout with a test-launcher/v1 record: one line per stage with kind, state and exit, and for test stages executed/passed/failed/ignored counts, runners and filtered, or executed=unknown why=TOKEN; then an overall line. The launcher reads only runner summaries (libtest `test result:` checked against `running N`; the node --test summary block). A stage fails on its exit or on failed tests counted by complete summaries. A count is numeric only when every summary is complete and consistent. Focused mode counts only cargo test and node --test started by the launcher. Detached runs write the record to launcher.log; summary and notify print none. No source revision is recorded. An unreadable log gives an unknown count without failing the run, and a stage that breaks request.json cannot take the record away. The format is agreed with Termal::Opus (reader tm-t9op) and documented in docs/development.md, "Record for the host". Round 13 was clean from Codex and Claude; the landing gate test-e2b7721c passed and its nine stages are recorded; readiness was ready on both live stores. Independent evaluation delegation-bad330a0 passed all six criteria.
